group.label: Appearance (White-label)
group.comment: Control how the affiliate storefront is styled. "Auto" makes it match your store theme automatically; "Manual" lets you pin exact brand colours; "Off" uses neutral defaults. All colour fields accept hex (#000000), rgb()/rgba(), or a CSS colour name. Leave a field blank to inherit the theme / use the default.

field.label: Theme Mode
field.comment: Auto: match the store theme at runtime. Manual: use the colours below. Off: neutral default styling.

field.label: Accent / Primary Color
field.comment: Main action colour (buttons, active list, highlights). Example: #5023CC. Leave blank in Auto mode to sample the store's primary button.

field.label: Accent Text Color
field.comment: Readable text colour shown on top of the accent colour (default: #ffffff).

field.label: Body Text Color
field.comment: Primary text colour for the storefront. Leave blank to inherit the store theme text colour.

field.label: Border Color
field.comment: Colour of card borders, dividers and the pager (default: #e3e3e3).

field.label: Card Background Color
field.comment: Background colour of the product cards (default: #ffffff).

field.label: Card Corner Radius
field.comment: Corner radius for product cards. Example: 10px, 0, 0.5rem. Leave blank for the default (10px).

field.label: Font Family
field.comment: Optional font-family stack for the storefront. Example: "Merriweather Sans", sans-serif. Leave blank to inherit the store theme font.
